[FIGHT IRON RULES / 武打动作铁律 — WEIGHT & RESULT]:
1) CONCRETE MOVES: name every technique with SPECIFIC martial-arts terminology ("扫堂腿 / leg sweep" ✔, never the vague "踢腿 / kicks" ✘) — the prompt decides HOW they fight, so be explicit.

3) BODY REACTION: the struck fighter's body reacts honestly — head snap, backward stagger, torso recoil, knee buckle, step-back recovery; never a no-reaction hit.
4) CONTINUOUS LOGIC: the exchange is a continuous logical chain — attack → hit/miss → reaction → counter; no teleporting, no resetting to idle between hits, no mindless flailing ("王八拳").
5) ACTION BEFORE DIALOGUE: in the same shot, ALWAYS complete the strike sequence first, THEN any dialogue — never talk while striking or the video degrades to slow-motion flailing.
6) ENDING: the fight ends with a clear result — decisive hit, KO, weapon drop, or mutual pause — never a fade-to-nothing.
【武打动作铁律·重量与结果】1) 具体招式：每个招式都必须用具体的武术术语命名（"扫堂腿"✔，绝不写笼统的"踢腿"✘）——提示词决定"怎么打"，必须明确。2) 命中反馈：每次有效攻击都有真实冲击——接触瞬间皮肤/衣料/肌肉震颤、汗水或尘土飞溅；冲击必须有重量感。3) 身体反应：被击者身体诚实反应——甩头、后仰踉跄、躯干回弹、屈膝、后退回稳；绝不出现无反应的挨打。4) 连续逻辑：攻防是连续逻辑链——攻击→命中/落空→反应→反击；两人之间不瞬移、不重置回站立、不乱挥拳。5) 动作先于台词：同一镜头中必须完整完成击打动作后再说话——绝不边打边说，否则视频会退化为慢动作乱挥。6) 收尾明确：战斗以明确结果结束——决定性命中、KO、武器脱手或互相停手，绝不无疾而终。

[COMBAT TRIGGER WORDS / 战斗触发词]: Use the H3 Combat LoRA trigger words when the workflow supports them: prfight1 (normal fight) always; add prfin1 when the fight needs a decisive KO/finish; add prslow1 (with an explicit slow-motion sentence) when the final blow should slow down on impact. 使用 H3 Combat LoRA 触发词（工作流支持时）：普通战斗必用 prfight1；需要决定性终结/KO 时追加 prfin1；需要最后一击命中瞬间慢动作时再追加 prslow1（并明确写出慢动作句子）。

[HIT FEEDBACK MASTERY / 命中反馈专精 — THE RESULT OF EVERY STRIKE]:
Every effective strike must show what REALLY happened after the blow:
1) CONTACT MICRO-MOMENT: at the instant of impact — skin/fabric/muscle ripple at the contact point, sweat or dust burst, hair/clothing whip from the force.
2) BODY DISPLACEMENT: the struck fighter is visibly displaced by the force — head snaps back, torso recoils, feet slide or lift, body rotates from the blow's direction; never absorb a hit standing still.
3) STAGGER & RECOVERY: after a heavy hit the struck fighter staggers (backward steps, knee dip, hands out for balance) and recovers with visible effort (wobble, shake head, reset stance) — the recovery IS part of the fight.

- 0.0–2.0s: 子弹极速飞来。正常速度。画面边缘枪口喷出火光（枪手在画外），一枚黄铜子弹以极速射出，拖着高速螺旋弹道线与空气撕裂的尖啸，直冲 <Subject 1>（参考图人物），弹壳从枪口右侧抛飞。子弹快到几乎看不清，尘埃被冲击波扬起。子弹在 2.0s 飞抵 <Subject 1> 胸前约一臂距离。
- 2.0s: 瞬间凝固。子弹骤然悬停几乎静止，拖尾的弹道光轨与气流波纹冻结在半空，音障水汽凝成细小的水珠。摄影机在凝固瞬间开始沿水平弧线环绕 <Subject 1> 旋转约40度并缓慢推近。
- 2.0–8.0s: 慢动作夹弹。时间凝固为超慢动作，整个夹弹过程以清晰的慢动作呈现，手指动作的每一帧都可见。
  - 2.0–4.0s: <Subject 1> 从腰部向后弯仰躲闪（矩阵式后仰），同时右手缓缓探出，食指与中指微微张开，向悬停的子弹靠近。发丝和衣角在凝固的空气中缓缓飘动。

overall_soundscape: 子弹出膛的高速脆响与破空尖啸（正常速度），凝固瞬间声音骤停，慢动作中子弹气流声拉长低沉，手指夹住子弹的金属轻响，弹壳落地叮当声，衣物与头发摩擦声，粗重呼吸。

detailed_description: The target video is a 10-second bullet time sequence using one continuous shot, with the two characters fixed in the selected STAGING (Option A side-by-side face-off or Option B front-back face-off, <Subject 1> in front near the camera in Option B). Bullet time (Bullet Time) camera work: the bullet first flies at extreme speed, then time instantly freezes into extreme slow motion, camera orbits ~40 degrees along a horizontal arc around <Subject 1> with a slow push-in, high-shutter crisp (equivalent 1/8000s), no motion blur, no limb distortion, no extra fingers.
- 0.0–2.5s: Normal speed. The two characters hold the chosen facing-off staging. <Subject 2> raises the gun toward <Subject 1>, pulls the trigger — muzzle flash, a brass bullet exits the barrel at extreme speed trailing a spiral ballistic line, shell casing flips out. Dust kicked up by the muzzle blast. The bullet reaches about an arm's length in front of <Subject 1> at 2.5s.
- 2.5s: Instant freeze. The bullet suddenly hangs almost motionless — its trailing ballistic light trail and air turbulence freeze mid-air, sonic vapor condenses into fine droplets. The camera begins orbiting ~40 degrees around <Subject 1> while pushing in slowly.
- 2.5–8.5s: Slow-motion catch. Time frozen into extreme slow motion; every frame of the finger action is visible. (For Option B front-back staging: <Subject 1> in front turns to a SIDE body profile and catches with ONE hand only.)
  - 2.5–4.5s: <Subject 1> bends backward from the waist (matrix dodge) while turning to a side body profile (Option B) and slowly reaching out ONE hand, index and middle fingers slightly open, moving toward the hanging bullet. Hair and clothing hem drift slowly in the frozen air.
  - 4.5–6.5s: Fingers close-up. The two fingers slowly clamp together, gently catching the hanging bullet from below — fingertips closing in bit by bit, touching the brass bullet head, the bullet head stopped firmly between the two fingers. The other hand stays relaxed at the side (single-hand catch). Camera stays close to the fingertips, the rifling grooves and scratches on the bullet clearly visible.
  - 6.5–8.5s: Clamp moment. Tiny sparks burst at the fingertip contact point, shockwave ripples outward in rings, hair and clothing blown back by the residual airflow. <Subject 2> holds the firing pose with muzzle smoke, shocked expression, staying in place. <Subject 1> holds the leaning pose for a moment, then slowly straightens up.
- 8.5–10.0s: Recovery. The bullet held still between two fingers of one hand. <Subject 1> fully straightens, opens the fingers and lets the bullet drop; <Subject 2> lowers the gun. Camera pushes in on <Subject 1>'s face. Environment from <Picture 3>@图3 slides slightly in parallax. The two characters keep their facing-off staging to the last frame.

After leaving the barrel until caught, there is only this one bullet.

[FIGHT IRON RULES / 武打动作铁律 — WEIGHT & RESULT]:
1) CONCRETE MOVES: name every technique with SPECIFIC martial-arts terminology ("扫堂腿 / leg sweep" ✔, never the vague "踢腿 / kicks" ✘) — the prompt decides HOW they fight, so be explicit.
2) HIT FEEDBACK: every effective strike shows real impact — the contact moment has skin/fabric/muscle ripple, sweat or dust spray; the impact reads with WEIGHT.
3) BODY REACTION: the struck fighter's body reacts honestly — head snap, backward stagger, torso recoil, knee buckle, step-back recovery; never a no-reaction hit.
4) CONTINUOUS LOGIC: the exchange is a continuous logical chain — attack → hit/miss → reaction → counter; no teleporting, no resetting to idle between hits, no mindless flailing ("王八拳").
5) ACTION BEFORE DIALOGUE: in the same shot, ALWAYS complete the strike sequence first, THEN any dialogue — never talk while striking or the video degrades to slow-motion flailing.

中景构图，摄影机缓慢前推，始终保持在两人侧面不越过轴线。<Subject 1>（参考图人物）持八面汉剑，<Subject 2>持齐眉棍/空心钢管。
- 0.0–1.2s: <Subject 1>进马右前刺——剑尖直刺<Subject 2>面门，剑路凌厉。<Subject 2>立棍格挡，棍身横架格开剑锋，金属碰撞发出清脆声响。
- 1.2–2.5s: <Subject 2>左横展棍横扫<Subject 1>头部，<Subject 1>低头闪避，同时右横斩剑——剑沿水平弧线斩向<Subject 2>腰侧。<Subject 2>架棍格挡，棍身被剑刃劈出火花。
- 2.5–4.0s: <Subject 1>下劈剑自上而下猛劈，<Subject 2>举棍上架，棍身弯曲受力。<Subject 1>左横切剑——剑从左向右平切<Subject 2>颈部，<Subject 2>后仰闪避，剑锋擦过鼻尖。<Subject 1>转身再横扫剑，<Subject 2>用棍尾格开。
- 4.0–5.5s: <Subject 2>抓住空档连续扫棍——左扫右扫连击，棍风呼啸。<Subject 1>连续闪避，剑随身转，突然近身直刺，剑尖直指<Subject 2>持棍手腕。<Subject 2>缩手后撤，棍法被破。
- 5.5–7.0s: <Subject 2>暴怒抡棍全力横扫，<Subject 1>不挡不闪，侧身贴棍而入，剑贴棍身滑进，剑尖抵住<Subject 2>咽喉。两人定格对峙，<Subject 2>僵住不敢妄动。
- 7.0–8.0s: <Subject 1>收剑后退，<Subject 2>也收棍戒备，两人呼吸粗重目光交汇。画面稳定流畅，无肢体畸形。

overall_soundscape: 剑刃破空的锐响，棍身碰撞的闷响，金属摩擦声，脚步移动声，粗重呼吸声，衣料挥动声。

[FIGHT IRON RULES / 武打动作铁律 — WEIGHT & RESULT]:
1) CONCRETE MOVES: name every technique with SPECIFIC martial-arts terminology ("扫堂腿 / leg sweep" ✔, never the vague "踢腿 / kicks" ✘) — the prompt decides HOW they fight, so be explicit.
2) HIT FEEDBACK: every effective strike shows real impact — the contact moment has skin/fabric/muscle ripple, sweat or dust spray; the impact reads with WEIGHT.
3) BODY REACTION: the struck fighter's body reacts honestly — head snap, backward stagger, torso recoil, knee buckle, step-back recovery; never a no-reaction hit.
4) CONTINUOUS LOGIC: the exchange is a continuous logical chain — attack → hit/miss → reaction → counter; no teleporting, no resetting to idle between hits, no mindless flailing ("王八拳").
5) ACTION BEFORE DIALOGUE: in the same shot, ALWAYS complete the strike sequence first, THEN any dialogue — never talk while striking or the video degrades to slow-motion flailing.
6) ENDING: the fight ends with a clear result — decisive hit, KO, weapon drop, or mutual pause — never a fade-to-nothing.
【武打动作铁律·重量与结果】1) 具体招式：每个招式都必须用具体的武术术语命名（"扫堂腿"✔，绝不写笼统的"踢腿"✘）——提示词决定"怎么打"，必须明确。2) 命中反馈：每次有效攻击都有真实冲击——接触瞬间皮肤/衣料/肌肉震颤、汗水或尘土飞溅；冲击必须有重量感。3) 身体反应：被击者身体诚实反应——甩头、后仰踉跄、躯干回弹、屈膝、后退回稳；绝不出现无反应的挨打。4) 连续逻辑：攻防是连续逻辑链——攻击→命中/落空→反应→反击；两人之间不瞬移、不重置回站立、不乱挥拳。5) 动作先于台词：同一镜头中必须完整完成击打动作后再说话——绝不边打边说，否则视频会退化为慢动作乱挥。6) 收尾明确：战斗以明确结果结束——决定性命中、KO、武器脱手或互相停手，绝不无疾而终。
